description: Generate the printable receipt PDF for one transaction. Pass the transaction object from mhlb_get_transaction — the endpoint renders that record, it does not look one up by id.

inline.description: Return the PDF as base64 in the result instead of writing it to a file. Default false.

isCreditType.description: Render as a credit rather than a payment. Default false.

transaction.description: The transaction detail object, as returned by mhlb_get_transaction.

name: mhlb_print_transaction
